name: seated-cable-crunch.html
instructions:
1. Place a flat bench in front of a high cable pulley machine. Attach a rope handle to the high pulley of a cable machine and select the appropriate weight.
2. Sit on the bench in front of the machine and hold the rope with both hands, bringing it around your head. This is the starting position.
3. Engage your core and pull the rope down by crunching your torso forward.
4. With your elbows fixed, continue to pull the rope towards your knees, focusing on contracting your abs.
5. Pause, then release the tension and slowly return to the starting position. This is one rep.
6. Perform the desired number of reps while maintaining control and good form.
